phase_a_orientation.summary: OrderService.createOrder(Order) is annotated @Transactional and performs two synchronous steps in sequence: repository.save(order), then publisher.publish("ORDER_CREATED:" + order.getId()). EventPublisher is a simple interface with publish(String). Thus the order-created event is currently emitted directly from the service immediately after save, using a string payload, with no visible outbox or after-commit mechanism in this workflow.
